full_judgment: 4. We upon considering the materials on record and considering that none of the witness including the husband Tuli and Moina was examined and due to their non-examination presumption would be that had they been examined they would not have supported the prosecution story raises a serious doubt as to the truth of the prosecution case and as such, we ' think that ends of justice would be best served if the conviction and sentence of the petitioner reduced to 7(seven) years rigorous imprisonment and pay a fine of Tk, 10001- in default, to suffer rigorous imprisonment for; 3(three) months more from the sentence of imprisonment for life and pay a fine of TK 10,000% in default to suffer further rigorous imprisonment I (one) year more.
